dependencyRationale: Backup restore consumes an existing system-picked archive, while backup/CSV export require a newly created destination. The typed router, native hosts, Android document port, iOS bridge and round-trip tests form one end-to-end contract.
fallbackReason: Platform-specific picker result types are generated across Kotlin/Swift boundaries, so both host implementations and the shared routing seam must be fingerprinted together.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Android Activity Results; UIKit UIDocumentPickerViewController
